headline: Meta's AI Will Now Alert Parents About Teen Self-Harm Chats
reasoning: This topic scores exceptionally high due to its potent mix of a major tech giant (Meta), a controversial technology (AI chatbots), and a deeply resonant mainstream issue (teen mental health and safety). It has massive viral potential, sparking debate over privacy vs. protection, and offers high practical value for millions of parents and teens. The story also lends itself to multiple engaging formats, from hot takes ('Is This a Lifesaver or a Privacy Nightmare?') to practical guides, making it a top-tier candidate for publication.
summary: Meta will now automatically notify parents if their teen discusses suicide or self-harm with its AI chatbot. The feature, part of Instagram's Parental Supervision tools, uses AI to flag conversations which are then manually reviewed before an alert is sent.

source_articles.title: Meta now alerts parents if their teen discussed suicide or self-harm with its AI chatbot
source_articles.excerpt: The updates come as Meta and other tech companies are facing scrutiny from regulators and parents around how AI chatbots respond to users in crisis, particularly teenagers.
